id: validation-Instance-Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities-case-2

pointer.content:
Test Case 2: Cross-Instance Retrieval

Input:
  - Run two separate opencode processes (Instance A and Instance B)
  - Use same (api_key, project_id) credentials
  - Create impulse in Instance A
  - Retrieve impulse from Instance B

Expected Output:
  - storeSuccess: true (Instance A stores impulse successfully)
  - retrieveSuccess: true (Instance B retrieves impulse successfully)
  - dataIntegrity: true (Retrieved data matches stored data exactly)

Validation:
  - Store impulse via Instance A using metabob_impulse_store
  - Load impulse via Instance B using metabob_impulse_load
  - Compare impulse data byte-for-byte
  - Verify metadata (created_at, project_id, api_key scope)
